title: Voice note
description: Talk about your calls and viewings. LeadWing sorts it into your clients, and nothing is saved until you check it.
holdHint: Tip: hold the + and talk. Let go when you're done.
tooShort: That was too short to hear. Talk a little longer.
micExplainer: LeadWing uses your microphone only while you record. Your browser asks once.
micDenied: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then try again.
unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Try Chrome, or Safari on an iPhone.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.disabled: Voice notes aren't switched on for your account yet.
errors.not_found: That voice note no longer exists.
errors.busy: That voice note is already being saved.
errors.audio_missing: The recording didn't arrive. Please record it again.
errors.transcribe_failed: Couldn't turn the recording into text. Try again in a moment.
errors.empty: I couldn't hear any words in that recording.
errors.extract_failed: Couldn't sort the note. Try again in a moment.
errors.upload: The recording couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.network: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

review.nothing: I didn't find anything to save in that note.
review.pickFirst: Choose who each card is about, or untick it.

saved.title: Saved
saved.summary: {count, plural, one {Saved for # client.} other {Saved for # clients.}}
saved.looseTasks: {count, plural, one {Plus # to-do without a client.} other {Plus # to-dos without a client.}}
